title: Switchboard Upgrade quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Replace existing ceramic fuse board with a new NHP Concept One IP65 24-pole surface-mount enclosure. Install one 63 Amp main switch, six 16 Amp RCBOs for general power and lighting circuits, one 20 Amp RCBO for the oven, and one 32 Amp RCBO for hot water. Install a type 2 surge protection device. Run five linear metres of 16 square millimetre consumer mains from the new switchboard to the existing service fuse. Install a new two point four metre earth stake and connect it to the main earthing bar. Conduct full testing and provide a Certificate of Compliance Electrical Work.
workingDetail: New switchboard enclosure, RCDs / safety switches, Circuit breakers (MCBs), Main switch
